plan: Given my value of $42, I aim to win the auction by bidding slightly below my value to ensure profit. Dominated bids are those above $42, as they guarantee a loss if I win. Bidding $41.9 maximizes my chance of winning while ensuring positive profit, as I will pay the third-highest bid. This strategy balances winning probability and profit maximization given the unknown bids of Betty and Charles.
